prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production game sprite animation sheet. Input image is the exact character identity reference. Create ONE transparent RGBA sprite sheet, exactly 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows (8 full-body frames), landscape 2:1 aspect, ideally 2048x1024. No captions, labels, borders, checkerboard, ground, or shadows. Keep the SAME cute 3D toy render, face, proportions, costume, colors, weapon, camera front three-quarter view facing SOUTH toward viewer across every frame. Do NOT redesign or mirror. All cells same camera and scale, boots grounded at same baseline (90% cell height), body center at cell center. Leave wide transparent padding; no overlap or cropped limbs. ROW ONE: four distinct walking poses looping: left leg forward/right back; passing pose right foot lifted; right leg forward/left back; passing left foot lifted. Clearly articulate hips knees boots and opposite arm swing, not sliding or deforming a still image. ROW TWO: four sequential attack poses: anticipation, windup, contact/release, recovery to ready. Real shoulder/elbow/weapon articulation. Keep head size and clothing consistent. ATTACK: hunched burdened steps then draw arms back, shove forward, recover; gold cargo remains.
